answer: Require every agent to stake a small bond that vests over a time horizon before it can transact. Each agent identity becomes a vertex in a reputation graph where peers attest real work done; an agent with no incoming attestations earns nothing. Sybil clones would each need their own bond plus months of honest work to reach the zenith of trust, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds and a thousand slow climbs, far more than any single fake transaction is worth.
